text: A WDAG based on chain forum combined with validation pools enables continuous updates to governance rules through expert community consensus that incorporates real time AI behavior data, which is what allows oversight to track self optimizing algorithms.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
